propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle, causing the patch to no longer intercept timestamp writes from those operations.

The integration test must patch _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle to restore its ability to detect regressions where moved binding operations unconditionally stamp updated_at fields.

The no-churn contract for unchanged reconciliation passes is now verified only at unit tier via test_binding_lifecycle.py, creating a coverage gap at the integration tier where mutations in moved operations would not be caught.
Audit of test_reconcile_idempotency.py confirms the _now_iso freeze at line 311 is the only binding_store-targeted patch whose subject moved to binding_lifecycle during RP-02 S2.
